attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Louisiana state income tax calculation. Implements flat 3% tax structure per LA tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Louisiana Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Single or Married Filing Separately
Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Head of Household

action_details.action_comment: Calculate LA tax with single/MFS standard deduction
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.la_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max result.la_tax_rate mul /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Louisiana tax calculated (Single/MFS): $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate LA tax with joint/HOH standard deduction
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.la_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max result.la_tax_rate mul /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Louisiana tax calculated (MFJ/HOH): $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Louisiana military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per LA Rev. Stat. § 47:293 (2025).

initial_action.action_description: Initialize Louisiana military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "Louisiana Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.la_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.la_sbp_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.la_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.la_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.la_military_retirement_exclusion result.la_sbp_exclusion add /result.la_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.la_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.la_adjusted_agi xdef
"Louisiana military retirement exclusion: $" result.la_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.la_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Louisiana SBP exclusion: $" result.la_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Louisiana total military exclusion: $" result.la_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
